game.title: Crash Bandicoot 4: It's About Time
game.blurb: Platformer from Toys for Bob, Beenox, Iron Galaxy Studios, Activision Shanghai and Hardsuit Labs (as RAWG lists them), released 2020-10-01. RAWG average playtime: 5 hours. Genres: Action, Platformer. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: Story and Bosses
chapters.summary: The main adventure and its boss fights, plus a few secret feats. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: The Masks
chapters.summary: Hidden achievements for using each of the four masks the Steam API names (dark matter, gravity, phase shift and time slow). Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Level Secrets and Extras
chapters.summary: Little secrets hidden in levels, bonus paths, a deathless run, skins and shutting up the bosses.

chapters.title: Timelines, Coco and Flashbacks
chapters.summary: Playing as Coco, finishing Timelines, and collecting Flashback Tapes and Flashback Relics.

chapters.title: Gems, Relics and 100%
chapters.summary: Clear and coloured gems, N. Sane and Time Trial relics, and the completion milestones.

chapters.title: The Backwards Mode
chapters.summary: Hidden achievements whose Steam API names say "bizarro": a first level, every level, a boss and all its clear gems. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Local Multiplayer
chapters.summary: Checkpoint Race, Crate Combo and Pass N. Play.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Steam app 1378990 is in the store list, so the game is on Steam, not only Battle.net. The Steam schema calls the app "Quartz" (an internal codename). 25 of 51 Steam achievements are hidden. Their Steam API names were used to sort them: the four mask_ achievements went to the masks chapter, the four with bizarro in the name (including gem_clear_all_bizarro) to their own chapter, the other gem_ and relic_n_sane_ ones and ending_100 and ending_200 to the gems chapter; the defeat_ boss achievements and the rest (high_jump, quisine, triple_spin_first and triple_spin_win) sit in the story chapter. The masks and the backwards mode are described only with words from the API names, not their in-game names. StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0, marked as a stub); its Walkthrough, Gameplay and Table of Contents subpages are linked but none exists, so nothing was used. crashbandicoot.fandom.com answers the API, with about 145 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied.
